leaves.name: x6CoarseModuliIdeal
leaves.doc: x6-coarse, printed form of x6CoarseModuli: the canonical model X6 = X0(6,1) over Q is a proper smooth curve and a coarse moduli scheme for abelian surfaces with QM by O: a bijection Psi on Qbar-points with QM pairs up to isomorphism, natural for Spec sigma, sigma in Aut(Qbar/Q) (X6ALIdeal.GaloisNatural: if Q is a base change of P along sigma, Psi(Spec sigma . x) = [Q]; Mumford GIT Def. 5.6), the Atkin-Lehner clause in the printed ideal-quotient form (for each m | 6 an automorphism w_m of X over Q sends [(A, iota)] to [(A/A[I_m], iota_m)], I_m = {a in O : m | nrd a} the two-sided ideal of reduced norm m, read as every O-equivariant isogeny with scheme-theoretic kernel A[I_m]; X6ALIdeal.ALIdealClause; Rotger, Trans. AMS 356 (2004)), and the classifying map of a level-3 QM abelian scheme over a proper smooth curve. Implies x6CoarseModuli with no hypothesis (X6ALIdeal.x6CoarseModuli_of_ideal: I_m = O mu_m and iota(mu_m) is such an isogeny onto (A, iota o Ad mu_m); the Galois clause is galoisClause_iff_natural); equivalent to it given the textbook fact X6ALIdeal.IsogenyQuotient. Locators UNVERIFIED (Shimura 1967; Deligne, Sem. Bourbaki 389; Buzzard, Duke 87 (1997) section 1).
leaves.flag: pending reading (Addendum 1: new printed leaf, GLUE until a reviewer rates it); locator UNVERIFIED; no reading risk left in the Atkin-Lehner clause (printed ideal-quotient form) or the Galois clause (literal naturality square at Spec sigma)
leaves.source: Shimura, Ann. of Math. 85 (1967) sections 2-3, Main Theorem I (canonical model of X0(D,N)); Deligne, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) sections 4-5 (moduli interpretation); Buzzard, Duke Math. J. 87 (1997) section 1 (X0(D,N) as a coarse moduli space of QM abelian surfaces); Rotger, Trans. AMS 356 (2004) (w_m(A, iota) = (A/A[I_m], iota_m)); Mumford GIT Def. 5.6 (coarse moduli scheme); locators UNVERIFIED

leaves.name: elkiesX6StarEveryIdeal
leaves.doc: x6-coarse: Elkies, Shimura curve computations (ANTS-III 1998, arXiv math/0005160) section 3 with Sigma = {2,3}: X*(1) = X(1)/W (p. 10, w_p : A -> A/ker I_p), X*(1) = P^1_t (p. 17), CM values t = 0, 1, infinity at discriminants -24, -4, -3 (Table 1 p. 26, pp. 22-23), Q(X(1)) = Q(t)(sqrt(-t), sqrt(3(t-1))) (p. 17); for every witness of the moduli description of X0(6,1) (R1fpPropsAb, X6Props) whose X carries the printed Atkin-Lehner automorphisms (X6ALIdeal.ALIdealClause), with no existence claim: some t : X6 -> P1 with Q(X6)^W = Q(t) for Elkies' isogeny-form W (X6ALIdeal.atkinLehnerWIdeal), the CM values, and the charts s^2 = -t, r^2 = 3(t-1). Replaces elkiesX6StarEvery (X6ALIdeal.elkiesX6StarEvery_of_ideal', with x6CoarseModuliIdeal, shimuraMainThmIDeligneY3AbU and T5); equivalent to it given IsogenyQuotient (X6ALIdeal.ideal_of_elkiesX6StarEvery).
